scientific_integrity: The contest limit, original logistic source and separate finite-community extension are explicitly distinguished. General moment inequalities and birth-death stationary formulas are acknowledged as pre-existing mathematical methods. No empirical claim, priority certification or independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to an idealized unit-bounded independent trait contest with a symmetric Beta(2,2) opponent and a separately defined pairwise winner-replacement community; not the empirical bivariate-normal noisy contest of the initiating article. Full moment envelopes are for hard comparisons only. Logistic sign robustness is proved only for the stated equal-moment pair at discrimination lambda>75. No evolving fitness, ecology field data, or independent validation.
title: Sharp lower-mean contest reversals and finite-population consequences under constrained abilities
